scenes.en: Meena held it closer and closer...
scenes.say: It's the weekend, and Meena has been on the tablet all day, holding it closer and closer.

scenes.en: Long hours of close-up screens and little daylight are linked to short-sight in kids.
scenes.say: Long hours on screens up close, with very little daylight, is linked to short sight in children.

scenes.en: Daylight and looking far away are good for growing eyes.
scenes.say: So Amma said, let's go out and play! Daylight and looking far away are good for growing eyes.

scenes.en: Studies show outdoor time can help lower the risk of short-sight in children.
scenes.ta: தினமும் சுமார் 2 மணி நேரம் வெளியே விளையாடட்டும்
scenes.say: Studies show that about two hours outdoors every day can help lower the risk of short sight in children.

scenes.en: Keep screens at a good distance and look far away often.
scenes.say: And when they do use screens, keep them at a good distance and take short breaks.

scenes.en: Kids rarely complain. See an eye specialist if you notice any problem.
scenes.say: Children rarely complain about blurry vision. So get their eyes tested every year, and see an eye specialist if you notice any problem.
